decisions.statement: A router app's server entry renders through here rather than rendering itself.
A server entry hands on what it was handed and states nothing of its own.
A stream is stopped a second past the ceiling the app states.
An error before the shell is written makes the response a five hundred.
An error after the shell is written is said to the console rather than answered.
A bot and a single-page app are answered only once the whole stream is ready.
How long a stream may take and what counts as a bot are the app's own.
A nonce that is not text is rendered as no nonce at all.
Nothing here reads a load context, so no app's own context is named here.

definition: the response a router app's server entry renders for one request
